# ♞ JevChess v1.3.0: can a decision model play chess?

The first public release of JevChess, a testbed for the **Jev decision model** (`typesafe/jev-1.13`) playing chess.
Jev chooses every move; **Luna** (`openai/gpt-6-luna`) reads the board; chess.js only supplies the rules. No chess engine.

▶ **[Watch Jev play in the live demo](https://shihabalratul.github.io/Jev-chess/)**: a real Lichess game where Jev checkmates Lichess AI level 2, with Jev's recorded reasoning on every move.

## Highlights
- **Chrome extension (Manifest V3):** Luna reads boards on web pages (HTML or `<canvas>`), Jev picks a move, and the extension plays it and verifies that the board changed.
- **Lichess bot:** plays real games through the official Bot API, with the token kept on your machine.
- **Staged decisions:** up to six questions per move (assess → forecast replies → nominate → shortlist → continue → choose).
- **Clock-aware Lichess play:** depth follows the clock, with tactical rule facts and a **blunder check** that asks Jev to reconsider moves that hang a piece or allow mate in one.
- **First results:** in six casual 10+5 games against Lichess AI levels 1–6, Jev won 2 and lost 4. All 176 moves were confirmed. That is roughly between AI level 2 and 3; it is a small sample, not a rating.

This release also contains the unreleased Lichess analysis work listed in the [changelog](https://github.com/shihabalratul/Jev-chess/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install
The extension needs the **local backend** to run, because that's where your API key lives. The zip alone isn't enough.

1. Clone the repo and run `pnpm install`, then `cp -n .env.example .env`.
2. Start the backend: `pnpm dev:server`, or for free with no API key, `PROVIDER_MODE=mock pnpm dev:server`.
3. Unzip **`jevchess-chrome-v1.3.0.zip`** below, open `chrome://extensions`, enable **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and choose the unzipped folder.

Full guide: [Getting started](https://github.com/shihabalratul/Jev-chess/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md) · Lichess: [bot setup](https://github.com/shihabalratul/Jev-chess/blob/main/docs/lichess-setup.md)

> A friendly reminder from the author's banned Chess.com account: most sites don't allow outside help against real people. Use the practice board, analysis boards, site bots or a Lichess BOT account. ♟️⚰️
